description.narrative: Based in Bangladesh, Badabon Sangho works on issues of land rights and land induced gender based violence against women, and climate change and its impact on girls and women, fisherfolks women and migrant workers rights and others. They do this through capacity strengthening and feminist movements building, engaging women at the community level who are facing the worst forms of violence regarding land disputes and are being displaced by land investors, and facilitating two networks: Women's Land Rights Network and National Women Migrant Worker Returnees Committee. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Core organizational costs such as staff salaries, training, office space and supplies, and strategic planning; - Capacity strengthening for members of the Women's Land Rights Network; - Quarterly coordination meetings of the Women's Land Rights Network; - Workshop on 'gender equality and group management'.
